workOrderId.title: Work Order Id
workOrderId.description: Current work order Salesforce id. Pass currentRecordId when the user does not name a wagon or work order.

assetId.title: Asset Id
assetId.description: Optional wagon or wheelset Asset id.

maxItems.title: Max Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of timeline entries to return. Set this from the user's request, e.g. 'last 5' or 'show 10' becomes 5 or 10. Leave blank for no limit.

dateRangeDays.title: Date Range Days
dateRangeDays.description: Look-back window in days. Set from phrases like 'last 30 days' becomes 30, 'past week' becomes 7, 'last 3 months' becomes 90. Leave blank for all time.

eventType.title: Event Type Filter
eventType.description: Filter the timeline. Set to 'measure' when the user wants only measures or inspection readings, or 'workorder' when they want only work orders. Leave blank to show both.
